name: Camp Bournedale
description_short: Co-ed summer day camp in Plymouth, MA for ages 7 to 14, Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM, with waterfront sports on Great Herring Pond, an indoor heated pool, field sports, rocketry, marine science and arts & crafts. A separate Little Guppies program (ages 4 to 6, 9 AM to 3 PM) is for younger children, who must be fully toilet trained.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on Great Herring Pond with tubing, wakeboarding, waterskiing, sailing, kayaking, a large water trampoline and a 15-foot iceberg, plus a large indoor heated pool. Little Guppies have swim lessons in the indoor pool. The pages do not describe swim testing or lifeguard ratios.

The contact email on the page is hidden, so it could not be recorded.
2026 discounts: $50 sibling discount or $50 multi-week discount from the 3rd week on, one discount per family, and only if enrolled by June 1, 2026.
